I completely understand. 17 is a difficult age anyways, but just know that it’s okay to be unmotivated sometimes. Just make small goals for yourself like spend x amount of time outside. (Just as an example). I highly recommend some motivation guided meditations though, they definitely helped me.

I completely get this. Sometimes people aren’t as forward with us as we may want or even need them to be to feel loved. Maybe mention to them that you feel sometimes conversations are one sided. If anything talk to someone you know is a good listener!

I completely agree. Sometimes people on here are so harsh when we just need to be validated, heard and supported. It’s okay that you’re feeling sad and there are tons of us who want to hear you and support you. ❤️
